Customer.title: Customer
Customer.description: A Kirana store customer with udhar/jama ledger balances and photo.

userId.description: The authenticated shopkeeper UID who owns this customer record.

phone.description: Phone number or landmark note for the customer.

photoBase64.description: Compact Base64 thumbnail photo or preset avatar identifier.

netBalance.description: Current net balance in INR (positive = Udhar due, negative = Advance jama, 0 = settled).

lastItemsSummary.description: Short summary of latest items taken on credit (e.g., Milk, Bread, Biscuit).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when customer was created (clients must write FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when customer was last updated (clients must write FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

TransactionEntry.title: TransactionEntry
TransactionEntry.description: An Udhar (credit given) or Jama (payment received) ledger transaction entry with items and photo.

userId.description: The authenticated shopkeeper UID who owns this transaction.

customerId.description: ID of the customer associated with this transaction.

customerName.description: Denormalized name of the customer for fast history display.

type.description: Transaction type: UDHAR (credit given) or JAMA (payment received).

items.description: List of Kirana items taken (e.g., Biscuit, Bread, Milk, Oil, Gutka).

photoBase64.description: Compact Base64 photo of the customer/items/bill for proof.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when transaction was created (clients must write FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when transaction was updated (clients must write FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}/customers/{customerId}.description: Per-shopkeeper customer khata profiles and running balances.

/users/{userId}/transactions/{transactio.description: Per-shopkeeper chronological udhar and jama transactions.
